responsibility: QNX Neutrino target configuration header for i386, defining the QNX predefines, thread model, startup and endfile sequence, linker specs, libc selection, type sizes, and debugger register policy. It adapts the generic x86 ELF backend to the QNX/Neutrino runtime and object-format conventions, including the platform-specific dynamic linker and import search paths.
same_name_distinction: The QNX Neutrino target configuration header that defines predefines and driver/link/startfile specs for the OS; unlike nto.opt, which only declares QNX-specific driver options like -G and -YP, this header implements how those options affect specs and runtime conventions.
